scientific_integrity: All computed classification cells are supported by standalone exact deterministic enumerators. Neither finite sampling nor an unavailable paper is presented as proof of uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: The classification concerns exactly the ternary-relational additive language over binary vector spaces and only quantifier ranks at most seven.
The finite root-type table follows by exhaustive execution of a mathematically justified orbit-type recurrence; there is no independent mathematical audit.
Historical priority, including implicit finite special cases in older treatments, is not established exhaustively.
title: A seven-round plateau for binary additive groups in the ternary relational language
